about: How this desk classes the host of an address an engine cited, on top of evidence/sources.json (incident.archivist@'s list, read first). 'primary' is a body that decides, warns or operates, on its own site; a statement counts as confirmed only when read there. Everything else is press, an aggregator (a site that rewrites or groups others' reports), an encyclopaedia or other. Hosts in evidence/sources.json's 'forbidden' and 'never' lists are never requested.
